payload.content: GitHub PAT in /root/.hermes/.env is fine-grained with read+write+issues but NO webhook permission. Creating repo webhooks returns 403 'Resource not accessible by personal access token'. Needed workflow: register webhooks manually via gh UI OR upgrade token to include webhooks:write on MadeAt2AM org. project.sh new auto-attempts registration and falls back to telling Chris exactly which payload URL + secret to use.
